title: Sage ids
description: The ids the loaded content defines, by record type, and the component tag ids. Generated by `sage schema` from the content it loaded (mods included); regenerate after adding a record.

id.description: A record id: name, or namespace:name. Lower-case letters, digits, _ . and -.

record:ability.description: The id of a ability record: one of those loaded, in full or bare (a bare id is the namespace of the file it is written in).
